test_cases.title: Logo returns the user to the home page from another page
acs: DERIVED: Clicking the logo in the navigation bar opens /Home.aspx - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/NavigationBar.ascx:43
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
/Help.aspx is used as the non-home starting page.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Help.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The Help page loads with the h1 Help and the logo with alt text Proficiency Testing homepage is visible in the navigation bar.

steps.action: Confirm the browser address ends with /Help.aspx.
steps.expected: The address path is /Help.aspx, so the user is not on the home page.

steps.action: Click the logo in the navigation bar.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the home page and the address path is /Home.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Stop on the home page without selecting anything else.
steps.expected: The user remains on /Home.aspx and no error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Footer links open the expected internal page for each link
acs: DERIVED: Footer Help link opens Help.aspx - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/Footer.ascx:12
DERIVED: Footer Accessibility Statement link opens AccessibilityStatement.aspx - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/Footer.ascx:13
DERIVED: Footer System Information link opens About.aspx - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/Footer.ascx:14
DERIVED: Footer Privacy Policy link opens PrivacyPolicy.aspx - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/Footer.ascx:15
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
All four footer links are internal and open in the same tab.
Data set: Help -> h1 Help; Accessibility Statement -> h1 Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website; System Information -> h1 About; Privacy Policy -> h1 VETQAS Privacy Notice.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user and scroll to the footer.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer shows the links Help, Accessibility Statement, System Information and Privacy Policy.

steps.action: Click the Help link in the footer.
steps.expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /Help.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the Help page.
Use the browser Back button to return to the home page.
steps.expected: The home page is shown with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer links are visible.

steps.action: Click the Accessibility Statement link in the footer.
steps.expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /AccessibilityStatement.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the Accessibility Statement page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Accessibility statement for the PT-LIMS website.

steps.action: Use the browser Back button to return to the home page.
steps.expected: The home page is shown with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer links are visible.

steps.action: Click the System Information link in the footer.
steps.expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /About.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the System Information page.
Use the browser Back button to return to the home page.
steps.expected: The home page is shown with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the footer links are visible.

steps.action: Click the Privacy Policy link in the footer.
steps.expected: The page opens in the same tab and the address path is /PrivacyPolicy.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the Privacy Policy page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Privacy Notice.
